<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL comparison examples, expecting continuation of structured test cases or explanations about query string parameter ordering.

The first URL example `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` sets up a contrast with a second URL, implying the second URL demonstrates a different behavior (e.g., missing parameters, different order, or only `flag`).

Final token `?flag` is the beginning of a second URL query string (`https://example.com/?flag`), immediately requiring completion — likely `=true` or a similar parameter value, mirroring the first example's `flag` parameter.
"Consider the following URL: `https://example.com/?foo=1&bar=2&flag=true`
Now consider: `https://example.com/?flag`" — expecting a parameter value or additional parameter continuing the pattern.</explanation>
